#!/bin/sh
# One call of kith-permit with a stand-in for the host: w.sh SIDE... MODE STDIN VERB ARGS...
#   SIDE  py KERNEL | rs BIN KERNEL
#   MODE  none | ask:NAME | run:NAME (a socket answering replies/NAME; no such file: it hangs up) | deadask | deadrun
#         http:NAME (the loopback API; KITH_SERVE_PORT is its port) | deadhttp (a port nothing listens on)
#   STDIN a file in in/, or - for none
side=$1; shift
if [ "$side" = py ]; then kernel=$1; shift; else bin=$1; kernel=$2; shift 2; fi
mode=$1; in=$2; shift 2
dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/kp.XXXXXX)
pid=
wait_ready() { n=0; while [ ! -s "$dir/ready" ] && [ $n -lt 200 ]; do sleep 0.05; n=$((n+1)); done; }
case $mode in
  ask:*|run:*)
    pid=$(python3 fh.py unix "$dir/s" "replies/${mode#*:}" "$dir/ready" >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo $!); wait_ready
    if [ "${mode%%:*}" = ask ]; then export KITH_ASK_SOCKET="$dir/s"; else export KITH_RUN_SOCKET="$dir/s"; fi ;;
  http:*)
    pid=$(python3 fh.py http - "replies/${mode#*:}" "$dir/ready" >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo $!); wait_ready; KITH_SERVE_PORT=$(cat "$dir/ready"); export KITH_SERVE_PORT ;;
  deadask) export KITH_ASK_SOCKET="$dir/none" ;;
  deadrun) export KITH_RUN_SOCKET="$dir/none" ;;
  deadhttp) export KITH_SERVE_PORT=1 ;;
esac
if [ "$side" = py ]; then
  if [ "$in" = - ]; then python3 "$kernel/bin/kith-permit" "$@" </dev/null; else python3 "$kernel/bin/kith-permit" "$@" < "in/$in"; fi
else
  if [ "$in" = - ]; then "$bin" kernel permit --kernel "$kernel" "$@" </dev/null; else "$bin" kernel permit --kernel "$kernel" "$@" < "in/$in"; fi
fi
rc=$?
[ -n "$pid" ] && kill $pid 2>/dev/null
rm -rf "$dir"
exit $rc
